preconditions: The subject is one Engineering person in the HR feed, correlated to one target account.
The subject has a lifecycle-owned Engineering entitlement.
The subject also has a manual grant, and may have an entitlement with both owners.
allowedChanges: Set the HR department from Engineering to Sales.
Remove the obsolete lifecycle-owned Engineering entitlement.
Grant the current lifecycle-owned Sales entitlement.
protectedState: An entitlement that still has a manual owner keeps its native membership.
The employee number stays the same.
Preexisting access is not adopted as lifecycle-owned.
